inventory.err_landed_cost_kind.en: Choose what this landed cost is for: freight, insurance, duty or import VAT.

inventory.err_inventory_type.en: Choose what kind of item this is: stocked inventory, non-stocked inventory, component, service or freight.

inventory.err_restate_sold_on_no_entry.en: {lot} was sold on {doc}, but that invoice has no posted entry of its own, so its cost of goods sold cannot be adjusted automatically. Correct it with a journal entry instead.

inventory.err_restate_sold_on_unroled.en: {lot} was sold on {doc}, but that invoice's entries hold a line on an account with no posting role, so Celerp cannot tell whether its cost of goods sold was posted. Correct it with a journal entry instead.

inventory.err_restate_sold_on_pending.en: {lot} was sold on {doc}, whose cost of goods sold Celerp has not posted yet. It is posted the next time Celerp starts, and the cost can be corrected after that.

inventory.err_restate_sold_on_ambiguous.en: {lot} was sold on {doc}, whose cost of goods sold was never posted because its lines cannot be matched to exact lots. Correct it with a journal entry instead.

inventory.err_barcode_taken.en: Another item already has barcode {barcode}. Use a different barcode, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_barcode_taken_unnamed.en: Another item already has this barcode. Use a different barcode, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_rfid_epc_taken.en: Another item already has RFID / EPC code {code}. Use a different code, or change it on the other item first.

inventory.err_rfid_epc_taken_unnamed.en: Another item already has this RFID / EPC code. Use a different code, or change it on the other item first.

error.unhandled_events.en: Records can't be rebuilt while these modules are turned off: {modules} ({events}). Turn them on in Modules, then try again.

mfg.no_recipe.en: This item has no recipe to make it from.

chart.parent_is_posting_account.en: Account {parent_code} is the posting account for {roles}, so no account can sit under it.

chart.parent_missing.en: Parent account {parent_code} is not in the chart of accounts.

chart.parent_type_mismatch.en: An account of type {types} cannot sit under {parent_code}, an account of type {type}.

fixed_assets.err_not_a_date.en: {field} {value} is not a date. Enter it as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-09-30.

fixed_assets.err_after_today.en: {field} {value} is after the company's today, {today} (time zone {zone}).

fixed_assets.err_locked.en: The books are locked up to {lock}. Use a date from {first}, or ask an accountant to unlock.

fixed_assets.err_method_settings.en: Method settings are a set of named values.

fixed_assets.err_not_a_setting.en: {name} is not a setting of this method.

fixed_assets.err_total_units.en: A units-of-use class needs the total units the asset is expected to produce.

fixed_assets.err_life_months.en: The useful life is a whole number of months.

fixed_assets.err_needs_life.en: A depreciated class needs a useful life.

fixed_assets.err_choose_role_account.en: Choose the {role} account in Posting accounts first.

fixed_assets.err_reading_missing.en: Enter the reading for {period} on {number} first.

fixed_assets.err_before_available.dispos.en: The disposal date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.sale.en: The sale date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.additi.en: The addition date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.availa.en: The available-for-use date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.reclas.en: The reclassification date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_before_available.measur.en: The measurement date is before {number} was available for use ({available}).

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.disposal.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Dispose on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.sale.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Date the sale on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.addition.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Add on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.available.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Place in service on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.reclassif.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Reclassify on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_changed_after.measureme.en: {number} was changed on {date} ({changes}). Measure on or after that date.

fixed_assets.err_rule_not_provided.en: {rule} is not provided by any installed module.

fixed_assets.err_rule_module_off.en: {rule} needs the {module} module, which is turned off.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.sold.en: {number} was sold on {date}. Void its invoice and cancel the sale on its page first.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.disposed.en: {number} was disposed of on {date}. Undo the disposal on its page first.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.undone_from_bi.en: {number}'s registration was undone. Its bill line is back in Register from bills, to register it again.

fixed_assets.err_left_use.undone.en: {number}'s registration was undone. Register it again to bring it back.

fixed_assets.err_cannot.undo_move.en: The move of {number} cannot be undone.

fixed_assets.err_op_key.en: Every change carries an operation key from its form.

fixed_assets.err_line_released.en: This line was registered and released since you opened this form. Press Review again.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale.one.en: {assets} changed since you reviewed it. Press Review again to see it as it stands now.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale.many.en: {assets} changed since you reviewed them. Press Review again to see them as they stand now.

fixed_assets.err_ended.sold.en: {number} was sold on invoice {invoice}. Void that invoice and cancel the sale on {number}'s page, then use Correct there.

fixed_assets.err_ended.disposed.en: {number} was disposed of. Undo the disposal on its page, then use Correct there.

fixed_assets.err_review_stale_unnamed.en: An asset, account or posting on this review changed since you reviewed it. Press Review again to see it as it stands now.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.registere.en: {assets} changed since it was registered. Use Correct on its page instead.
{assets} changed since they were registered. Use Correct on each one's page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.done.one.en: {assets} changed since this was done. Use Correct on its page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.done.many.en: {assets} changed since this was done. Use Correct on each one's page instead.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.run.one.en: {assets} changed since this run. Use Correct on its page to change its depreciation.

fixed_assets.err_changed_since.run.many.en: {assets} changed since this run. Use Correct on each one's page to change its depreciation.

fixed_assets.err_run_not_reversible.en: The {month} run can no longer be reversed.

fixed_assets.err_run_posted.en: Depreciation for {month} is already posted. Open its run to see it or reverse it.

fixed_assets.err_month_not_ended.en: {month} has not ended yet. Depreciation runs for a month once it has ended, so the latest you can run through is {last}.

fixed_assets.err_import_rows_with_proble.en: Fix or leave out the rows with problems first: rows {rows}.

fixed_assets.err_import_exclude_numbers.en: Leave out rows by their row numbers.

fixed_assets.err_import_no_such_row.en: There is no row {row} in this file.

fixed_assets.err_import_no_rows.en: The file has no rows to import.

fixed_assets.err_import_too_many_rows.en: Import at most {max} rows at a time. Split the file and import each part.

fixed_assets.err_import_at_cutover.en: The register is imported as at the cutover {cutover}.

fixed_assets.err_recon_at_cutover.en: The reconciliation starts at the cutover {cutover}.

fixed_assets.err_sale_many_clearing.en: {number}: the document cleared its line through more than one account ({accounts}).

fixed_assets.err_no_such_asset.en: Celerp couldn't find this asset. It may have been deleted.

fixed_assets.err_sale_on_draft.en: {number} is on draft invoice {invoice}. Finalize or delete that invoice, or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_sale_on_void.en: {number} is waiting on void invoice {invoice}. Reissue or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_sale_draft_deleted.en: {number} is waiting on a sale whose draft invoice was deleted. Reissue or cancel the sale from the asset's page.

fixed_assets.err_credit_kind.en: Choose whether the credit note credits part of the price or takes the asset back.

fixed_assets.err_credit_no_sale.en: {number} has no completed sale to credit.

fixed_assets.err_credit_over.en: Only {amount} of the sale of {number} is left to credit.

fixed_assets.err_unsell_credit_note.en: {number} has credit note {credit_note} on this invoice. Void that credit note first.

fixed_assets.err_unsell_returned.en: {number} was returned with credit note {credit_note}. Void that credit note first.

fixed_assets.err_credit_already_returned.en: {number} was already returned with a credit note on this invoice.

fixed_assets.err_return_amount.en: A return credits what is left of the sale of {number}: {amount}.

fixed_assets.err_sale_doc_by_person.en: {numbers}: a document selling or crediting an asset is changed by a person.

fixed_assets.err_sale_keep_line.en: {number} is waiting on this invoice. Keep its line, or cancel the sale from the asset's page, which voids this draft.

fixed_assets.err_sale_module_off.en: {numbers}: turn on Fixed Assets to sell an asset.

fixed_assets.err_sale_not_here.en: {number} is not being sold on this invoice. Sell it from its page, which drafts its invoice.
